question: The efficiencies of X and Y are in the ratio 6 : 5. If X can finish a work in 70 days, how many days will Y take?
solution: Time goes the other way to efficiency: times X : Y = 5 : 6. Y takes 70 × 6 ÷ 5 = 84 days.
